fields.summary_ko.0: Lakewood Capital Management made new or additional investments in SK hynix (SKHY:NASDAQ), Brink's (BCO:NYSE), and S&P Global (SPGI:NYSE) in its $340 million fund, but SK hynix has fallen 44% since September 30 and trades at approximately 3x forward P/E.
fields.summary_ko.1: Brink's and S&P Global rose 12% and 11%, respectively, over the same period, with adjusted earnings per share increasing 18% and 9% respectively, reflected in analysts' raised target prices.
fields.summary_ko.2: SK hynix is valued as undervalued reflecting the end of the memory boom, with an average analyst target price of $259.50 (151% upside from current price), with over 50% of 2027–2028 production capacity under advance contracts.
